name: CLOBYOSH
description: Clobyosh (classic Bela or Klaberjass) is considered by many experts to be the finest two-player card game in existence. It combines the Jass-style trump ranking (J-9 high) with a unique melding phase and a 'Schmeiss' (Throw-in) rule. The game is played worldwide, particularly in Jewish communities, the Netherlands, and the Balkans. It is an intense duel of hand evaluation, bluffing (in melds), and precise endgame calculation.

content.text: Clobyosh (classic Bela or Klaberjass) is considered by many experts to be the finest two-player card game in existence. It combines the Jass-style trump ranking (J-9 high) with a unique melding phase and a 'Schmeiss' (Throw-in) rule. The game is played worldwide, particularly in Jewish communities, the Netherlands, and the Balkans. It is an intense duel of hand evaluation, bluffing (in melds), and precise endgame calculation.
Likely originated in the 17th or 18th century within Jewish communities in the Netherlands or Hungary. The name 'Klaberjass' may relate to 'Klaverjas' (Dutch for Jack of Clubs).

Two players only. One is the dealer and one is forehand (the dealer's opponent, who speaks first in bidding). The dealer rotates after each hand; there are no partnerships and each plays for their own score toward 501.

Deal 6 cards to each player (3-3). Turn the next card face up (The Proposal). Bidding follows. Once a trump is settled, deal 3 more cards to each player (total 9 each). The bottom card of the deck is turned face up (for information only).

items.text: Bela (Croatian): National variant. Often played to 1001. 4-player partnership version also popular.
Alsatian Clob: No 'Schmeiss' rule. Simplified bidding.
